Inspect the embedded corpus

The manifest below identifies whether this edition contains Base64-encoded standard gzip or plain uncompressed UTF-8 JSON. Both formats are integrity-checked before the corpus is parsed; neither format requests browser permission.

  1. Extract the text inside the inaSearchCorpusData element.
  2. For a gzip edition, Base64-decode and decompress it; for an uncompressed edition, save the extracted text directly as JSON.
  3. Compare the resulting byte counts and SHA-256 hashes with the manifest above.
  4. Open the UTF-8 JSON in a text editor.
